svg.title: Chocofi 36-key Urob keymap
svg.desc: Visual reference for all six layers, thumb prompt macros, layer behaviors, and combos in this repository.

g.text: Generated from config/base.keymap, config/corne.keymap, and config/combos.dtsi
hold Space · arrows gain line/document actions on long tap
tap Num = num-word · double tap = sticky layer · hold = momentary
toggle with F + P · smart auto-off behavior
Right outer → “Take a step back. Formulate a broader…”
Prompts type into the focused field and never press Enter.
Space: tap Space · hold Nav · Shift+tap “. ” then sticky Shift
Num: tap num-word · double-tap sticky Num · hold Num
Magic Shift: repeat-aware Shift · Shift+tap/double-tap Caps Word
Fn + Num → System · F + P → smart Mouse toggle
W+F → Esc · F+P → Mouse · L+U → Backspace · U+Y → Delete
R+S → Tab · S+T → Leader · R+S+T → Shift+Leader
X+D → Cut · X+C → Copy · C+D → Paste
Bracket combos become braces on Nav; parentheses become angle brackets.
Leader + A/O/U/S → ä / ö / ü / ß
Leader + USB / BLE → output · RESET / BOOT → device controls
Canonical source: config/*.keymap and config/*.dtsi · Update this graphic whenever behavior changes.
